issues.problem: The heading says 'Amounts in Swedish kronor (SEK)', but the workbook amounts are in thousands of SEK (TSEK). Readers would understate every figure by a factor of 1,000. The heading should read 'Amounts in thousands of Swedish kronor (TSEK)' or equivalent.
issues.evidence: RR!A4, BR!A4, BR!A43, KF!A4 = "Belopp i TSEK (thousands of SEK)"; e.g. RR!B7 Turnover = 932 817 (TSEK), printed as Revenue 932,817 under a heading of SEK
